title: Platform Operations & Recovery Engineering
subtitle: A saved backup becomes recovery evidence only after a restore test.
scenario: A small cloud platform needed reliable operational records, controlled running costs and a recovery path that did not depend on experimenting with its live database or exposing secret material.
outcome: Make recovery repeatable, keep operational evidence useful and stop temporary resources without confusing a paused service with an uninstalled component.
flow: Restore into an isolated temporary target
Remove rehearsal resources and record evidence
notes: The default demo uses a synthetic SQLite database for a fast portable rehearsal.
Sanitized PostgreSQL scripts preserve the actual network-isolated restore pattern; they require a reviewed image and separate execution.
Measured local milliseconds are not a production RTO or an application-consistent cloud recovery guarantee.
boundary: Sanitized patterns from an operational platform; this screen shows local code with fictional records.
